live_iq.server: SAP IQ 17.1 (a HANA Cloud data lake), through SQL Anywhere 17's dbcapi over TLS

iq17-tds.login: dbcapi cannot log in over TDS: the TDS login's options (sp_tsql_environment's) are set as temporary options on a CmdSeq connection

live_iq.tables: the parity schema as IQ-store tables ll_<name>, owned by the user, each re-seeded when it is not as schema.yaml says (checked on every run); each case's table references rewritten to them (an owner DBA read as the user)
live_iq.timeout: 60 s per statement, cancelled by the client (HDLADMIN may not set request_timeout)
live_iq.settings: a case's query-level settings are temporary options on a connection of its own; a database property or a PUBLIC option given other than this server's, a SET statement at the user's or PUBLIC's level, and an option HDLADMIN may not set (-121) are answered not_judged
live_iq.sqlSha: as SQL Anywhere's answers' but with no decision and no expect: real IQ judges an iq17-* run
live_iq.confirmed: on --write, a run whose answer differs from its iq16 twin's SQL Anywhere answer is run twice and must answer alike
